id: Traskforce! Ft. Eugene Wolfin-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Traskforce! Ft. Eugene Wolfin
long_description:
Starring Eugene Wolfin on vocals, the octet will present a fizzing set of big band swing, Broadway hits, and gorgeous ballads. Hear the fine lyricism of the 20th century sung by one of Wellington’s most exciting performers.

Free entry! Koha encouraged.

For the last 8 years vocalist Eugene Wolfin has been a regular of Wellington music scene performing in a wide variety of genres including Jazz, Blues, and Rock ’n’ Roll. He has had a hand in a few local Musical Theatre productions performing lead roles in ‘Chess’ and the modern hit ‘If/Then', and is a regular in front of Jazz Orchestras including the Royal New Zealand Air Force Band and the Rodger Fox Big Band.

Traskforce! is bandleader Alex Trask’s most swinging musical organisation. They play fresh arrangements of original compositions, classic swing, and Broadway ballads. This includes songs from the Basie repertoire, Bob Mintzer, Oliver Nelson, Quincey Jones, and Lionel Bart's Oliver! to name a few. The five horn arrangements allow for the power of a big band and the subtlety of a quartet to shine side by side. The band is made up of Wellington’s top players, including members of the Aotearoa Jazz Orchestra, the RNZAF band, NZSM faculty, and rising stars.

Photo by Oscar Laven

id: The Racket Lounge-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The Racket Lounge
long_description:
Grab a spot on our couch and enjoy the noise at The Racket Lounge - a chill classical music series showcasing up-and-coming Pōneke musicians.

If you’ve never been to a classical concert before, or if you have and now you want to see talented emerging musicians experimenting and playing what they want to play, then The Racket Lounge is for you. Over the past two seasons we’ve seen classical covers, jazz ensembles, video game soundtracks, original compositions, loop pedals, poetry and much more. Our 2026 season is shaping up to be just as epic, plus with your tickets starting at just $5 you can afford to take a chance on something new.

Each concert will feature a different line up of musicians and genres, to be announced a week before each session. If you’re a musician looking to perform at The Racket Lounge, then head to the New Zealand String Quartet’s website to see how to apply.



The Racket Lounge is created and presented by the New Zealand String Quartet Trust - Te Rōpū Tūrū o Aotearoa, New Zealand’s longest-running professional string quartet. With support from Wellington City Council.

Tickets are choose your price starting from just $5.

Please note that Bedlam & Squalor is a licensed venue, so under 18s must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. Everyone must bring ID.

id: George Young And Band-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: George Young And Band
long_description:
George has been called “Wellingtons best kept secret”. A soulful songwriter that stretches styles and sonic scenes. A great voice in great musical company. George has been in the mix for a while and he has a raft of new and unheard material. From heart-melters to shoe-movers, you will not be disappointed.

Band:
George Young
Jeremy Desmond
Jason Rapana
Andy Hoy

Music from 9:00pm, FREE ENTRY
